title: poa macrocalyx subsp. tatewakiana
intro: Poa macrocalyx subsp. tatewakiana, commonly known as Tatewaki's meadow grass, is a plant species in the family Poaceae. It is a type of grass native to Japan, valued for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Poa macrocalyx subsp. tatewakiana include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which may help to reduce inflammation and protect against oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to exhibit sedative and antispasmodic effects, possibly due to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that have been found to have antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties.
